model_budget_bounds.name: model_budget_bounds
model_budget_bounds.value: "model_budgets"."max_calls" between 1 and 100 and "model_budgets"."used_calls" between 0 and "model_budgets"."max_calls" and "model_budgets"."max_micros" between 1 and 100000000 and "model_budgets"."per_call_micros" between 1 and "model_budgets"."max_micros" and "model_budgets"."reserved_micros" >= 0

observation_outcome.name: observation_outcome
observation_outcome.value: ("course_observations"."status" = 'succeeded' AND "course_observations"."revision_id" IS NOT NULL AND "course_observations"."error" IS NULL) OR ("course_observations"."status" = 'failed' AND "course_observations"."revision_id" IS NULL AND "course_observations"."error" IS NOT NULL)
